lessons.key: ac_gap::when a write stores a nested dto that get later exposes assert the get payload field not only the write side column
lessons.text: When a write stores a nested DTO that GET later exposes, assert the GET payload field not only the write-side column.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when two fields on one row must stay independent seed both then assert the untouched field after the write
lessons.text: When two fields on one row must stay independent, seed both then assert the untouched field after the write.

lessons.key: ac_gap::a disable 404 guard is not enough assert stored rows still exist after the flag is off
lessons.text: A disable/404 guard is not enough: assert stored rows still exist after the flag is off.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when the spec requires naming the invalid field assert the error property or message not only the http status
lessons.text: When the spec requires naming the invalid field, assert the error property or message not only the HTTP status.

lessons.key: ac_gap::for list payloads assert each required item field protocol outcome duration not only page size
lessons.text: For list payloads, assert each required item field (protocol, outcome, duration) not only page size.
